silhouette.reason: Unmistakable grizzly: shoulder hump, dished face, round ears, heavy forelegs, short tail; the hump reads against the back line in SIDE.
fixes: break the outline with a few fur clumps on the hump and belly so it is not a smooth hull

proportions.reason: Ears now sit at a plausible size and the head, hump and leg masses match a grizzly photo by eye at 1.7 m.
fixes: thicken the forearms ~5% at the wrist for a heavier adult paw

materials.reason: The textured coat reads as fur with grizzled tips, ears are body brown, nose dark and the claws pale keratin; only a faint baked top-light remains on the back and shoulders.
fixes: de-light the albedo further (divide out the remaining top light on the back) so it relights correctly in engine

detail.reason: Claws on each paw, scars and fur grain hold in the hero, but the outline is a smooth hull: no fur clumps break it on the back, belly fringe or legs, and the face has little plane structure in close-up.
fixes: a strand/shell or card pass on the back, belly fringe and backs of the forelegs so the outline breaks into fur clumps
sharper brow and muzzle planes in the Blender step (eye sockets, lip line)

wear.reason: Three healed claw scars on the shoulder and darker, dirtier paws and lower legs tell a life outdoors; the coat is otherwise clean and evenly groomed.
fixes: wet/matted darker fur on the lower legs and belly, a rubbed patch on the flank

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 is nearly indistinguishable from LOD0 at that distance: outline, colour blocks and scars hold.
fixes: drop LOD2 to ~3k triangles; the far view does not need 5k

technical.reason: QA clean; 30k / 10k / 5k triangles over 2 draws with idle, look and walk clips.
fixes: spend the LOD2 savings on the face at LOD0 (eye sockets, lips)
